text.title: Shop database
text.intro: Three tables created by the one migration; the checks and keys live in the database, not in the code.
text.entity books: what the shop sells, one row per ISBN
text.field books stock: copies on the shelf; paying an order lowers it
text.field orders status: one of placed, paid, shipped, cancelled; the database refuses any other value
text.entity order_lines: which books an order holds and how many
text.rel order_lines order_id orders: deleting an order that has lines is refused
text.rel order_lines isbn books: a line must point at a book that exists
